reusable_lessons.lesson: Executive communications and stakeholder-facing reports must cite the source of every numeric claim. Each metric should include a [source: ...] reference to its origin (artifact or metrics key) to ensure reproducibility and enable stakeholders to verify findings.

Analytical writing must carefully distinguish between association and causation. Use associative language ('is associated with', 'correlates with') unless a causal relationship has been rigorously established through experimental design or causal inference methods. Avoid causal phrasing ('causes', 'drives', 'leads to', 'because of') in claims-analysis communications.
